title: list_contacts: a line for each contact held

ground_estimates.description: The side's estimates of the enemy's men ashore (decision 0092, 19), one for each hex, in the area if one is given. Estimates, not counts: they may be wrong. Left out when the side holds none.

submarine_reports.description: The side's reports of enemy submarines (decision 0218, stage 3), in hex order and in the area if one is given, each possibly out of place. Reports only, kept apart from contacts. Left out when none.

age_pulses.description: The pulses since it was made.

suspected_waters.description: The waters where the side suspects enemy submarines work (decision 0218, stage 3), in the order it was told, those centred in the area if one is given. Left out when none.

distance_hexes.description: How many hexes round the centre.

submarine_estimate.description: The side's estimate of the enemy's boats (decision 0223, stage D1), made from its own reports of submarines and kept nowhere: areas in the order they were begun, each with an about count, and the side's own bases named by habit where its scenario says so. Those areas centred in the area and those bases lying in it if one is given. Left out when it holds nothing.

areas.description: The reported areas. Left out when none.

place.description: The centre: the hex of the first report.

distance_hexes.description: How many hexes round the centre.

reports.description: The hexes of its reports, in hex order.

days.description: The days of its reports, each once, in order.

by_habit.description: The side's own bases where boats may be expected, in base number order, with no count. Left out when none.
